title: SLDBench v2: Active Scaling Law Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.16297v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling laws predict large-model performance from small experiments, but finding a reliable law itself requires costly experiments. SLDBench tests whether language-model agents can discover scaling laws when all experimental results are given upfront. We introduce SLDBench v2 with two extensions. First, we expand the corpus from 8 to 127 scenarios spanning language-model pretraining, downstream performance, and vision-language transfer, and select 30 challenging scenarios on which a reference power-law fit reaches $R^2 \le 0.8$; they represent at least $1.09 \times 10^{23}$ FLOPs of source-reported training compute. Second, we introduce active scaling law discovery: an agent chooses which experiments to run, pays each one's recorded cost (e.g., training FLOPs), and revises its law as outcomes arrive, and is scored on the same hidden extrapolation targets as in the passive setting. translated_title: SLDBench v2：主动缩放定律发现
translated_abstract: 缩放定律能够通过小规模实验预测大模型的性能，但找到一个可靠的定律本身就需要付出昂贵的实验代价。SLDBench 测试语言模型智能体在所有实验结果都预先给定的条件下能否发现缩放定律。我们推出 SLDBench v2，包含两项扩展。第一，我们将语料库从 8 个场景扩展至 127 个场景，涵盖语言模型预训练、下游性能以及视觉-语言迁移，并选取了 30 个具有挑战性的场景——在这些场景上，参考幂律拟合的 R² ≤ 0.8；这些场景代表着至少 1.09 × 10²³ FLOPs 的源报告训练计算量。第二，我们引入了主动缩放定律发现：智能体可以自行选择要运行哪些实验，为每个实验支付其记录在案的成本（例如训练 FLOPs），并随着结果的到来不断修正其定律，同时在与被动设定相同的隐藏外推目标上进行评分。在 8 个前沿智能体系统中，中位数 R² 从……
tldr: SLDBench v2 将缩放定律发现从被动拟合扩展为主动实验设计，要求智能体在支付真实计算成本的约束下自主选择实验、迭代修正缩放定律，并基于覆盖 127 个场景、高达 10²³ 级 FLOPs 计算量的隐藏外推目标进行严格评测。
en_tdlr: SLDBench v2 extends scaling law discovery from passive fitting to active experiment design, requiring agents to autonomously select experiments, pay their recorded computational costs, and iteratively refine scaling laws, evaluated on hidden extrapolation targets across 127 scenarios representing over 10²³ FLOPs of training compute.
